name: PR416 owner-fix validation
# rerun after test compile correction

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - evidence/pr416-current-head-validation
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/pr416-owner-fix-validation.yml

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  owner-fixes:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: evidence/pr416-current-head-validation
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'
      - name: Generate projects and restore
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python3 tools/dotnet-ci/generate_projects.py
          dotnet restore tools/dotnet-ci/TacticalDirector.gen.sln

      - name: Run Shot Mechanics assembly
        shell: bash
        run: |
          dotnet test src/shot-mechanics/Tests/shot-mechanics-tests.gen.csproj \
            --no-restore \
            --logger "console;verbosity=normal"

      - name: Run save-restore tackle latch lock
        shell: bash
        run: |
          dotnet test src/match-engine/tests/match-engine-tests.gen.csproj \
            --no-restore \
            --filter "Name=SaveAndRestoreCarryTheTackleLatches" \
            --logger "console;verbosity=detailed"

      - name: Run frozen InPoss detector
        shell: bash
        run: |
          dotnet test src/match-engine/tests/match-engine-tests.gen.csproj \
            --no-restore \
            --filter "Name=sim_match_engine_inposs_gate" \
            --logger "console;verbosity=detailed"

      - name: Run main-relative regression targets
        shell: bash
        run: |
          dotnet test src/match-engine/tests/match-engine-tests.gen.csproj \
            --no-restore \
            --filter "Name=AControlledCarrierIsActuallyDispossessed|Name=BothOutcomesOccur_TheBallIsSometimesWonAndSometimesKnockedLoose|Name=TacklesHappenInComposedPlay|Name=ATackleFoulIsGivenAsASlideTackleAndNotJudgedTwice|Name=sim_match_engine_shot_outcomes" \
            --logger "console;verbosity=detailed"
